THE GOOD:
• Unrivaled Python deep code analysis, auto-imports, and smart refactoring
• Built-in database manager, interactive Jupyter Notebook support, and virtual environment manager
scenes.voiceover_script: First, the strengths. JetBrains PyCharm excels at unrivaled python deep code analysis, auto-imports, and smart refactoring and offers built-in database manager, interactive jupyter notebook support, and virtual environment manager.

THE BAD & PRICING:
• Heavy Java JVM resource usage; can be slow to start on low-end machines
• Model: Freemium
scenes.voiceover_script: On the flip side, keep in mind that heavy java jvm resource usage; can be slow to start on low-end machines. As for pricing, it's structured as Community Edition is 100% Free (Open Source). Professional Edition is ~$10-$25/month with Web/Django/Database tools..
